ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast between dominant low-intensity black pigmentation (RGB approx 10-30) and localized high-intensity white clusters (RGB approx 230-255) at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation base across both lobes. Discrete white contiguous pixel clusters at the far lateral distal tips. Scattered white focal points (1-5 pixel diameter) distributed along the interior margin of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate 65-degree interior angle and distinct vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (10-30 pixels deep) along the continuous boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the upper margins of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense white circular pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; smaller, isolated white punctate marks scattered across the dark central-right lobe region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, near-vertical gray-scale linear disruptions visible on the lower-medial section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced white scarring or colonization clusters present at the distal-most tips of both the left and right lobes.
